purpose: Record the user approval of Bella MXF Kind rules before reviewing MXF Duration.
status: Approved requirements; no Bella runtime implementation or cutover.

authorization.source: Direct human approval in the current conversation
authorization.statement: OK, let's lock those Kind rules in for Bella. Next, how do Media Composer, MDVX and MediaMuster read Duration from MXF, and what should Bella read and keep?
authorization.scope: Approves the preceding focused MXF Kind proposal. Requesting Duration research does not approve its new mappings or other pending MXF field/navigation choices.

agreedBellaRules.authority: The already qualified essence-linked physical file SourcePackage and its own uniquely usable descriptor class; binary class identity with established MXF label/version handling.
agreedBellaRules.unknown: Nonspecific, data, unsupported or unavailable descriptions supply no MXF Audio/Video Kind. Display lowercase unknown if no other eligible source supplies Kind.
agreedBellaRules.singleAuthority: No filename/extension, compression-label, overall master-track or separate DataDefinition vote. Do not carry over inference from audio/video property presence on an unrecognised class.
agreedBellaRules.ownershipAndDamage: Broken ownership or ambiguous/unusable descriptor selection withholds MXF Kind. An unrelated damaged numeric value need not erase a valid known class. Retain the physical file and independent usable facts.
agreedBellaRules.multipleDescriptor: The wrapper is not a Kind. In supported compatibility handling, classify only an already uniquely qualified applicable owned child; otherwise unavailable. Do not choose the first child or expand into general interleaved-MXF support.
agreedBellaRules.retention: One compact enum with necessary availability; generate Audio/Video/unknown labels later. Reuse then release temporary descriptor/header facts. C++17 enum class/fixed-array building blocks suffice; no new dependency.

tradeoff: An unfamiliar descriptor can remain unknown where OldScanner would infer Audio/Video from registered property presence. Add new known classes deliberately. No measured performance improvement or universal app parity is claimed.
unchanged: The approved six-class MDB Kind mapping and Kind-versus-Type meanings.
